title: Bluetooth speaker experiment (14 subjects, 6 classes, 31 EEG ch)
description: A P300-based brain-computer interface dataset for home appliance control, comprising EEG recordings from 14 healthy subjects performing a visual oddball task with 31-channel recordings at 500 Hz sampling rate. The dataset includes 50 training and 30 testing trials per subject, with binary target and non-target stimulus classifications presented via LCD display in an online BCI paradigm.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 31-channel actiCHamp system (Brain Products) at 500 Hz sampling rate with linked mastoids reference and active sensors. Participants performed a P300 oddball task with visual flash stimuli presented on an LCD display at 750 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. The standard 10-20 electrode montage was used with 60 Hz line frequency filtering.
